build_pelican_site: build a local version of the pelican static site using the base settings configuration
serve_pelican_site: serve the pelican site on localhost:8000 using a custom TCP server with address reuse
clean_pelican_output: remove all generated files in the pelican output directory and recreate the folder
publish_pelican_rsync: build the production pelican site and deploy it to a remote server via rsync over ssh
deploy_pelican_ghpages: build the production pelican site and publish it to GitHub Pages using ghp-import
